title: Round 27: round 25's DAgger net2 on net1 v10 (32 LCFs) reading the means, three seeds
description: Round 25's recipe unchanged (experiments/net2-r25-v9.json: round 18's DAgger gate3 students, teacher gain 0.5, the rule at u = 0.25, 60 iterations, validation every 20) on net1 v10 (release exp-net1v10-266: net1 v9's 27 LCFs plus departure_rate_bps, available_capacity_bps, overload_bps, bdp_pkts and cross_arrival_rate_bps, so net2 reads them by name instead of building them), reading the means, seeds 1 to 3. Its twin is round 28 on neto1 v3.
run: S="$OUT/spec-r27-$VIEW-s$SEED.json"; jq --arg view "$VIEW" --argjson seed "$SEED" '.algo = "dagger" | .student = {"kind": "gate3", "threshold": 0.5} | .view = $view | .share_k = 0.5 | .critic_warmup = 0 | .lr = 0.001 | .updates_per_iteration = 50 | .replay_iterations = 16 | .tau_s = 1 | .noise_sigma = 0.05 | .group = 1 | .links_per_iteration = 32 | .compete = 0.8 | .copies = [2, 4] | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 60 | .eval_every = 20' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-r27-$VIEW-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
